description_en: Removes multiple hosts from an asset group at a time
description_zh: 从指定资产组中批量移除主机
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost remove-hosts-from-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-group-id 1 --host-ids 1_,_2_,_3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveHostsFromGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host whose asset group you want to manage.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
要移除主机的资产组所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host whose asset group you want to manage.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要移除主机的资产组所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset group from which you want to remove hosts.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html operation to query the asset group ID
parameters.help_zh:
要移除主机的资产组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the hosts that you want to remove from the host group. Specify a JSON string. You can specify up to 100 host IDs.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to query the host IDs
parameters.help_zh:
要移除的主机ID。该参数为JSON格式的字符串，最多支持输入100个主机ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取主机ID
parameters.name: host_ids

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Code.description_en:
The return code that indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

OK: The call was successful.

UNEXPECTED: An unknown error occurred.

INVALID_ARGUMENT: A request parameter is invalid.

Make sure that the request parameters are valid and call the operation again.

OBJECT_NOT_FOUND: The specified object on which you want to perform the operation does not exist.

Make sure that the specified bastion host ID and host IDs are valid and call the operation again.

OBJECT_AlREADY_EXISTS: The specified object on which you want to perform the operation already exists
Code.description_zh:
接口的调用结果信息。取值：
OK：操作成功。
UNEXPECTED：未知错误。
INVALID_ARGUMENT：请求参数设置错误。

请检查请求参数，确保参数正确后重新调用接口。

OBJECT_NOT_FOUND：操作的对象不存在。

请检查该堡垒机实例的ID是否存在，主机是否存在，主机ID是否填写正确，然后重新调用接口。

OBJECT_AlREADY_EXISTS ：操作的对象已存在

HostGroupId.description_en: The ID of the asset group

Message.description_zh: 该参数已废弃，无需关注
